_about: Aussie Bush pack: Egg karaoke recordings, generated with tools/gen-sounds.js --manifest tools/packs/aussie.karaoke.json and chosen, pitched and levelled by tools/pick-karaoke.js --manifest tools/packs/aussie.karaoke.json (which only adds to sounds/index.json). inst = the bush band's two new instruments (banjo lead, spoons backbeat); sing = each friend's sound in the band (a call that holds a steady note sings the tune, anything else plays as it is); extra = its ad-lib in the gaps. Same format and rules as tools/karaoke.json.
common: close-up, isolated, no music, no speech, no background noise
commonInst: one single isolated note, dry studio recording, no reverb, no other instruments, no melody

sounds.prompt: A single banjo string plucked, one bright twangy note
A single clack of two spoons played as a folk percussion instrument
A galah calling once, one clear chirpy screech on a steady note, cute, not harsh
A cockatoo giving one single short cheeky squawk, not harsh
A kookaburra giving one single short hoo from its laugh, on a steady note
An emu giving one single soft deep drumming boom on a steady note
One single springy cartoon boing of a little kangaroo hop
A baby wombat giving one single soft short grunt
A baby platypus giving one single soft short churr
One single small quick snuffle from an echidna nose
A sugar glider giving one single tiny high yip
One single soft papery flutter of a little lizard's frill opening, fwip
A bilby giving one single tiny high squeak
A mole cricket giving one single short trill on a steady note, like a soft whistle
A galah flapping its wings while swinging upside down, a soft feathery flutter
A cockatoo cracking a seed with its beak, one crunchy crack
A kookaburra flapping its wings and landing on a branch
An emu chick running fast on dry ground, quick pattering footsteps
A joey wriggling around inside a soft furry pouch, soft rustling

A little lizard scampering quickly over dry leaves

A mole cricket burrowing through soft soil, tiny crumbly digging
